title: Insurance Claim Repairs Price List — Unrelated-Damage Additions
content:
**Pricing clause.** An unrelated-damage addition to an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order is priced when its customer-pay addition consent is signed, from the labor hours written on that consent. The price is the consent's labor hours times the panel hourly rate of **USD 104.00**, which covers body labor together with paint and materials, plus shop supplies at **6 percent** of that work amount, plus the hazardous waste fee of **USD 6.95**, rounded to the cent.

## Price lines

| Line | How it is stated | Rounding |
|---|---|---|
| Work amount | labor hours on the consent multiplied by USD 104.00 per hour | to the cent |
| Shop supplies | 6 percent of the work amount | to the cent |
| Hazardous waste fee | USD 6.95 | — |
| Price | the work amount, plus the shop supplies, plus the hazardous waste fee | to the cent, once at the end |

The shop supplies are measured on the work amount, never on the waste fee. The hours are the hours written on the consent being priced, to one decimal place.

## Worked prices (hypothetical consents)

**5.5 labor hours.**
- Work amount: 5.5 hours at USD 104.00, USD 572.00.
- Shop supplies: 6 percent of USD 572.00, USD 34.32.
- Hazardous waste fee: USD 6.95.
- Price: USD 572.00 plus USD 34.32 plus USD 6.95, USD 613.27.

**2.3 labor hours.**
- Work amount: 2.3 hours at USD 104.00, USD 239.20.
- Shop supplies: 6 percent of USD 239.20 is USD 14.352, rounded to USD 14.35.
- Hazardous waste fee: USD 6.95.
- Price: USD 260.50.

## Basis Q&A

**What does the hourly rate include?** Body labor together with paint and materials; materials are not priced as a separate line.

**On what amount are shop supplies figured?** On the work amount — the hours times the hourly rate — after it is rounded to the cent.

**When is the price fixed?** When the customer-pay addition consent is signed; the price is the one the hours on that consent give.
